intelligence.essence: Finish the membership structure system — complete it — so he can put his videos in. A membership with no finished structure is a house with no rooms: the videos have nowhere to live, and the citizen has nowhere to belong.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine building a beautiful clubhouse — but the rooms aren't finished yet, so there's nowhere to put the movies! We have to finish the rooms first — the doors, the shelves, the cozy corners — and then the movies can move in and everyone can come watch them!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — he's got all these wonderful videos ready, dear, but the membership house isn't finished yet, so there's nowhere to put them, love. Finish the house first — the rooms, the doors, the little lock on the front gate — and then the videos can move right in, dear, and everyone can come and enjoy them.
